content.short: Cod3x is an AI trading terminal for deploying autonomous agents that trade perpetuals.
content.description: Cod3x takes a trading strategy written in plain English and has an AI agent execute it on perpetual futures around the clock. A prompt sets the scope, leverage cap, per-trade risk and schedule, such as BTC and ETH momentum on Hyperliquid at no more than three times leverage with two percent risk per trade. More than a hundred perp markets are available and the architecture is non-custodial, so funds stay in the user's wallet. The team set out its agent design in a paper on the ATLAS-3 model.
content.meta: Deploy autonomous agents that trade perpetuals on your behalf from a single terminal.
